name: Build DocStat Android APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm install
          npm install -D @capacitor/assets

      # Automatically packages your folders into www/ on the fly during cloud build
      - name: Prepare Web Assets for Capacitor
        run: |
          mkdir -p www/Subjects
          mkdir -p www/InfoHTMLs
          
          # Copy main HTML file
          cp app.html www/index.html 2>/dev/null || cp index.html www/index.html
          
          # Copy files into their respective subfolders inside www
          cp Subjects/*.js www/Subjects/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cp InfoHTMLs/*.html www/InfoHTMLs/ 2>/dev/null || true
          
          # Copy root assets (images, icons, etc.)
          cp *.png www/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cp *.jpg www/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cp *.svg www/ 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'zulu'
          java-version: 17

      - name: Add Android platform if missing
        run: |
          if [ ! -d "android" ]; then
            npx cap add android
          fi

      # Generate Android App Launcher Icons from edge-to-edge icon.png
      - name: Generate App Icons
        run: |
          mkdir -p assets
          cp icon.png assets/icon.png
          npx @capacitor/assets generate --android --assetPath assets

      - name: Sync Capacitor Android
        run: |
          npx cap sync android

      # Update App Name in Strings.xml
      - name: Update App Name in Strings.xml
        run: |
          STRINGS_PATH="android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml"
          if [ -f "$STRINGS_PATH" ]; then
            sed -i 's/<string name="app_name">.*<\/string>/<string name="app_name">DocStat<\/string>/g' "$STRINGS_PATH"
          fi

      # Restore keystore from GitHub Secret and verify existence
      - name: Restore Keystore from Secret
        env:
          KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          echo "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/android/app/release.jks"
          ls -lh "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/android/app/release.jks"

      # Auto-increment versionCode so updates are accepted by Android
      - name: Auto-Increment Version Code
        run: |
          sed -i 's/versionCode 1/versionCode ${{ github.run_number }}/g' android/app/build.gradle || true

      # Sign and build release APK using your GitHub Secrets
      - name: Sign and Build Android Release APK
        working-directory: android
        env:
          KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }}
        run: |
          chmod +x ./gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleRelease \
            -Pandroid.injected.signing.store.file="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/android/app/release.jks" \
            -Pandroid.injected.signing.store.password="$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" \
            -Pandroid.injected.signing.key.alias="$KEY_ALIAS" \
            -Pandroid.injected.signing.key.password="$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" \
            --no-daemon

      # Rename built APK for a clean custom filename
      - name: Rename APK
        run: |
          mkdir -p final-apk
          cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk final-apk/DocStat-v${{ github.run_number }}.apk || cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/release.apk final-apk/DocStat-v${{ github.run_number }}.apk

      # Upload the renamed signed APK artifact
      - name: Upload APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: DocStat-v${{ github.run_number }}-APK
          path: final-apk/*.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
